editorial:
Imagine being the best in the world at kicking demons out of people, only to find out your own father is the one who needs help. You get pulled into a wild ride where the rules of faith are thrown out the window. It starts off like a typical scary movie with dark rooms and creepy noises, but it quickly turns into a giant puzzle. You will feel the tension as the main character tries to save his dad, while wondering if the thing inside him is actually evil or something much bigger and scarier. It is a creepy setup that keeps you guessing about who is actually the bad guy.

The acting is top notch and the twists will really catch you off guard. While some parts of the story move a bit slow in the middle, the ending makes up for it with a huge shock. If you love stories that make you question everything, you need to see this. You should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to get all the detail, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a big collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move because the visuals look amazing.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you find out the entity isn't a demon at all. It is actually a piece of God that came to earth to judge humanity. The son realizes that trying to cast it out was a mistake because you cannot fight the creator. The movie ends with the entity taking over completely, leaving the father as a shell and showing that humans are powerless against a truly holy force.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves supernatural mysteries and religious horror.
